create_efficientvit_config: create an EfficientViTConfig instance with custom num_classes, widths, and depths for a detection model
load_efficientvit_config: load an EfficientViTConfig from pretrained weights using the S3DownloaderMixin
save_efficientvit_config: save an EfficientViTConfig instance to disk for later model initialization
configure_efficientvit_model: configure an EfficientViT model with custom decoder_hidden_size, patch_size, and layer_norm_eps
override_efficientvit_dropout: override EfficientViTConfig dropout probs and initializer_range for fine-tuning
